name: Pterodaustro
sum: Flamingo-like filter feeder from the Early Cretaceous of San Luis, Argentina, with about a thousand bristle-like teeth.
wsnote: Maximum adult about 3 m and 9.2 kg.
holotype: PVL 2571 (femur) — Lagarcito Formation, San Luis, Argentina.
material: Over 750 specimens from all growth stages, from egg to adult.
exceptional: Embryo in an egg (2004) and 3D eggs (2014); possible medullary bone.
biology: Strongly upcurved jaws with a comb of long bristle-teeth for straining crustaceans and plankton. Bakker suggested a flamingo-like pink colour from its diet.
author: Bonaparte 1970
